claims.claim: Tesla has registered 158 Cybercabs in Texas as of October 2, 2026.
claims.episode_span: Tesla has registered one hundred fifty eight Cybercabs in Texas, more than doubling the fleet in under two weeks.
claims.source_title: Tesla Cybercab Fleet Hits 158 in Texas: Your Questions Answered
claims.supporting_quote: Tesla has now registered 158 Cybercabs in the state, adding 32 vehicles in the latest batch.

claims.claim: Elon Musk said Tesla cut the AI5 chip’s memory in half to 72GB and the AI6 chip’s memory by a third to 144GB.
claims.episode_span: Elon Musk said Tesla cut the AI5 chip’s memory in half to seventy two gigabytes. The AI6 chip’s memory was cut by a third to one hundred forty four gigabytes.
claims.source_title: Elon Musk Says Tesla Cut Optimus Robot Memory to Scale Production - Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA)
claims.supporting_quote: In a post on X, Musk said Tesla cut the AI5 chip’s memory in half to 72GB and the AI6 chip’s memory by a third to 144GB.
